Style: High-contrast minimalist poster design, modern streetwear editorial aesthetic, sports-card/music-poster fusion, crisp geometric composition, bold negative space, distressed print texture, grainy halftone, limited palette of crimson red, white, black, purple, and dark blue.

title: 粘土宇航员月球市场
author: 古一
categories: 漫画 / 分镜,3D 渲染,赛博朋克 / 科幻,角色,风景 / 自然
prompt_en: A whimsical handcrafted clay diorama of a night market on the moon, photographed like a miniature cinematic set. The ground is dusty gray lunar soil with small craters and uneven texture, and the background is a deep black sky scattered with many tiny warm-white stars plus one visible cratered moon in the upper left. Show 5 small astronauts in chunky vintage-style white spacesuits with rounded helmets and dark glossy visors, posed as market vendors and customers. Build 4 rustic market stalls from rough wood poles and stone-like counters, each topped with draped fabric canopies in muted blue-gray or rusty red tones. Hang warm glowing orange paper lanterns from the stalls and string 6 round bulbs across the back of the market, creating a cozy contrast against the cold lunar setting. In the left foreground, place a large stall with 2 astronauts: 1 vendor behind the counter serving food from bowls and trays, and 1 customer with a backpack facing the stall. In the mid-background, place 2 smaller stalls with 1 astronaut standing between or near them as if browsing or buying. In the right foreground, place 1 red-canopy stall filled with breads, pastries, jars, and baskets. Near the center front, add a rough circular stone table with 4 low round stools; one astronaut sits beside it holding a cup or bowl, and the tabletop holds 4 small plates or food groupings. Scatter several foil-wrapped silver cargo crates around the scene, including 1 in the left foreground and a cluster on the right side. The overall style should feel tactile and handmade, like stop-motion puppets and sculpted clay miniatures, with detailed textures, warm practical lighting from lanterns, shallow depth of field, and a charming, surreal blend of space exploration and cozy street food market.\

title: 科学动物运动分析HUD
author: @AIライフハック
categories: 信息图 / 教育视觉,摄影,3D 渲染,动物 / 生物,图解 / 图表
prompt_en:
1:1 square composition. Suited for video material. Please provide a photorealistic depiction of a cheetah moving in its natural habitat, captured in a high-speed tracking shot from the side.
The camera is a medium-long shot, pulled back sufficiently. The composition ensures the entire body is completely within the frame, with no clipping of major parts like the head, torso, legs, wings, fins, or tail. The subject is placed in the center safety zone, within 60-70% of the horizontal width, leaving margins on all sides. A lateral silhouette moving from left to right. The background has a light horizontal motion blur, while the subject is in sharp focus.
Accurately overlay a transparent 3D skeleton or appropriate anatomical layer on the body, emphasizing muscles, joints, the extension of the spine and trunk, and propulsive parts like legs, wings, fins, and tail. Semi-transparent blue/white base with red or orange accents on key areas.
Display a fixed-layout semi-transparent HUD at the edge of the screen. The UI should not obscure the subject and must have the same placement every time.
Top Left: Circular speedometer
Top Center: Acceleration/Force/Propulsion panel
Top Right: Stride/Flap/Swimming rhythm graph
Bottom Left: Muscle/Skeletal/Joint legend
Bottom Center: Motion phase timeline
Bottom Right: Small energy efficiency/balance chart
Maximum of 4 annotations. Short English labels only. Clean, sci-fi documentary-style UI in white, cyan, and light blue. Numbers are for reference; avoid long text or dense UI. Cinematic natural lighting, high definition, photorealistic, organized scientific documentary style.
Avoid: Close-ups, body clipping, limbs out of frame, multiple animals, extra legs, distorted joints, human-like skeleton, unreadable text, crowded UI, giant graphs, UI hiding the subject, excessive light effects.\

prompt_en: Create an ultra high-end conceptual chest-up studio portrait of a mysterious male public figure standing front-facing behind a tall transparent vertical refractive glass panel. The composition is centered and symmetrical, cropped from the upper thighs to just above the head, with the shoulders broad and still. Use a deep cinematic blue studio background with a subtle gradient from dark navy on the left to cooler luminous blue on the right. The glass panel should create vertical sliced distortions, faint duplicate ghost silhouettes offset to both sides, and thin vertical refraction lines running from top to bottom. Add exactly two prominent horizontal prism light streaks: one crossing the face area at eye level in cyan, blue, orange, and white, and one crossing the lower chest area in cyan and orange; include soft motion blur and spectral dispersion around the streaks. Lighting should be dramatic and editorial, with cool rim light, glossy reflections, high contrast, and a premium conceptual photography look. Make the portrait sharp in the clothing and body silhouette but distorted through the glass, with no text, no logos, and no extra objects.\
